Mixed older reviews (declining service, tipping pressure per summaries on review mirrors) with a stronger current Google score - inference: reputation has swung and review follow-up is ad hoc

scores.reasons: Gap: has booking and prices, but the site is a single anchor page with no schema and a new-tab booking jump. Pay: multi-therapist shop, $60-$160 tickets, still small. Ease: small static site, quick rebuild. Evidence: site, robots.txt, Google profile and review mirrors all read directly.

caveats: Google Maps was read through the limited (non-signed-in) view: star rating, category, hours status, phone, website and claim status are visible, review counts are not. Review counts quoted from Birdeye/localitybiz/BestProsInTown are second-hand and labelled as such.

None of these are chains or franchises, but three of the ten (Trim Master, Harmony, IAM) could not be tied to a fully verifiable Google presence, which limits confidence in any recommendation for them.

Inferences are labelled inline; the main ones are that Trim Master has likely closed or been replaced at 37 S Main St (Macor's now trades there), and that H & L / Harmony scheduling and intake are manual given their size.
data_gaps: Google review counts for all ten businesses (the limited Maps view does not expose them).
Trim Master Barber Shop: directories give 37/39/111 S Main St, Milltown with one shared phone that Google cannot resolve; no Maps listing under any of those names. Status recorded as 'not found'.
Harmony Day Spa: no Maps listing surfaced by name, address or phone (732-518-8352); existence rests on directory/aggregator reviews, so current operation is not independently confirmed.
East Pretty AB Spa: two overlapping listings at 444 Ryders Ln with different phone numbers ((917) 667-5821 vs (732) 414-9785); which is current is unresolved.
Swan Spa: township regulatory/licensing records were referenced in search results but not opened or verified, so licensing status is not assessed.
No contact or booking forms were submitted anywhere; form field labelling was assessed only from page structure on sites that had forms.
Screenshots were captured for four sites at 390px (New Jersey Nails, AquaSpa, MT Massage, H & L Wellness); the six businesses with no website had no layout to review.
